implementation.contract: complete HTML document with a real head meta element whose name is generator and whose content is non-empty

heldout.limitation: The frozen held-out repositories contained no positive family for this contract, so they confirm precision but not positive sensitivity. The predicate was not retuned after reveal.

performance.gate: material only when the control-adjusted increase exceeds both 5 percent and 5 milliseconds

residual_no_go.check: No producer-independent declaration or source/output relation is available in the checked-in Autoconf Archive HTML; ecosystem tokens would be an allowlist.
residual_no_go.pydantic: Observed mypy snapshot families mix maintained inputs with outputs and expose no producer-independent declaration; path or MYPY annotation rules would be allowlists.
